title: 西班牙高铁事故冲击选情 桑切斯面临执政考验
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The Spanish Prime Minister, Pedro Sanchez, has called a snap election after Parliament rejected his housing plan that was meant to quell protests across the region.
segments.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯在议会否决其住房计划后宣布提前大选，该计划旨在平息各地抗议。

segments.en: When the train accident happened, obviously, this changed the whole strategy.
segments.zh: 火车事故发生后，显然改变了整个策略。

segments.en: The high-speed rail collision near Erda in the province of Toledo, on October 28, killed 69 people.
segments.zh: 10月28日，托莱多省埃尔达附近的高铁相撞事故造成69人死亡。

segments.en: It was a major, major blow for the socialist party.
segments.zh: 这对社会党是一次重大打击。

segments.en: The political responsibilities are not optional, they are essential.
segments.zh: 政治责任不是可选项，而是必不可少的。

segments.en: This story is all about Sanchez fighting to stay in power after eight years, and the possibility that not only will the Conservatives win,
segments.zh: 这个故事讲的是桑切斯在八年后为保住权力而战，以及不仅保守党可能获胜，

segments.en: but that the far right will have a lot of leverage over the government.
segments.zh: 而且极右翼将对政府拥有很大影响力。

segments.en: Could the Toledo train crash flip the Spanish boats? Pedro Sanchez has been struggling in polls. He's been really weak.
segments.zh: 托莱多火车事故会改变西班牙的选情吗？桑切斯在民调中一直挣扎，他真的很弱。

segments.en: He saw an opportunity there to jump in and call a snap election, in which he could present himself as the person trying to solve the crisis,
segments.zh: 他看到了一个机会，跳出来呼吁提前大选，在其中他可以把自己塑造成试图解决压力的人，

segments.en: and the person who had solutions, which he says the right will not have.
segments.zh: 以及拥有解决方案的人，他说右翼没有这些方案。

segments.en: Then everything changed. A high-speed rail service has slammed into another train about 60 miles south of Madrid in Spain.
segments.zh: 然后一切变了。一列高铁在西班牙马德里以南约60英里处撞上了另一列火车。

segments.en: Early findings point to technical failure and human error, but when officials singled out an individual worker,
segments.zh: 初步发现指向技术故障和人为失误，但当官员单独指出一名工人时，
